test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: One of the goals of the Namami Gange Programme is to:

options.text: perform religious rituals with water from the Ganga River
start river cruises on the Ganga River to boost tourism
increase the supply of the Ganga River water for drinking purposes

solution:
The correct answer is __**revitalise the Ganga River**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One of the primary objectives of the **Namami Gange Programme** is to **revitalise the Ganga River**.
 
• The programme aims to achieve effective abatement of pollution, conservation, and rejuvenation of the Ganga River.
 
• It encompasses various activities such as sewage treatment, river surface cleaning, rural sanitation, and afforestation.
 
• The initiative is crucial for restoring the ecological balance and ensuring the sustainable management of the river.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Namami Gange Programme** was approved as a flagship programme by the Union Government in 2014.
 
• It is implemented by the **National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG)** and its state counterparts, known as State Program Management Groups (SPMGs).
 
• The programme also focuses on promoting public awareness and community participation in the efforts to clean and rejuvenate the Ganga River.
 
• It is a comprehensive initiative that addresses both the short-term and long-term needs for the sustainable management of the river.
 
• The programme has received significant funding and support from the government, international organizations, and various stakeholders.
